name: NY Steak with Herbed Polenta Fries & Tomato Bell Pepper-Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Halve each tube of polenta crosswise, then cut each half lengthwise into ½-inch thick "fries." Divide between two large baking sheet pans, spreading the fries out in a single layer.
Drizzle fries with oil and season with spices; carefully toss to coat, then spread out on the baking sheets so that none of the fries are touching.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping fries halfway through, until golden brown and slightly crisp on the outside, 35-40 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the fries have about 15 minutes left of cooking, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Halve tomatoes and place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips; add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Add arugula to the bowl, along with the dressing, and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak, polenta fries, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
